rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for the Surrealist artistic movement and its aesthetic philosophy.

example.english: Surrealism advocates opening up the subconscious and letting the imagination run free.
example.traditional: 超現實主義主張打開潛意識，等想像力自由發揮。

rows.note: Use this for surreal-style art generally, without claiming that it belongs to the Surrealist movement.

example.english: This painting uses surrealism, with a fish swimming across the ceiling.
example.traditional: 呢幅畫用咗超現實藝術，條魚仲喺天花板度游水。
